label: needs-work
must_catch: the title describes what the claim is and names no result/margin; the reviewer should flag it and propose a concrete rewrite that states who won and by how much, e.g. 'You.com tops SimpleQA-20 at 90%; Keenable last at 65% but 2× faster'
must_not_catch: a substance violation — the benchmark is sound and reproducible, so the reviewer must not invent a runner/reproducibility/faithfulness problem
note: real pattern: a benchmark that's sound underneath, but the title describes the claim instead of stating the result ('per-query visual report — see what each API matched')
